scope: all input/output interface artifacts independent of modality or MIME type

payload_storage.text: repository content or content-addressed repository artifact
payload_storage.binary: content-addressed artifact or privacy-preserving external object reference plus exact digest
payload_storage.sensitive: digest-and-metadata receipt unless explicit policy authorizes bytes

granularity.unit: smallest independently attributable and independently testable knowledge/work unit

proof.rule: publication metadata MUST state the exact proof/evidence class and MUST NOT promote a model-relative proof to empirical confirmation

automation.publication_effects: automatic only when all configured effect gates and credentials are satisfied
automation.missing_credentials_or_external_service: persist BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_EFFECT receipt and retry through scheduled continuation
automation.semantic_noop: persist receipt; do not publish duplicate noise

acceptance_criteria: no I/O event is silently dropped
every event receives a content-addressed durable receipt
duplicates do not create publication noise
new knowledge is never called proved without a declared machine-verifiable evidence class
Zenodo routing is deterministic for eligible stable artifacts
IETF routing occurs only for protocol/interoperability results
external-effect failures remain retryable and auditable
effect acknowledgement is reobserved and persisted
